shots.prompt: Extreme close-up locked at ground level the whole time: a black leather boot steps down off a helicopter skid and sinks into deep fresh snow, rotor wash blasting snow across the frame, dusk. Only the boot and the lower leg of the black trousers are ever in frame; the camera never tilts up and no face or body is shown

Wide slow push-in: a black helicopter lands in a vast frozen Russian valley at dusk, dark pine forest and grey mountains, rotor wash blasting snow into the air, a single dark silhouette of a broad man in a long coat in the open door, no face visible
Close-up, slow push-in: he slowly raises his sunglasses and slides them on, snowflakes falling past, his breath fogging, he looks into the lens

Low-angle slow-motion steadicam shot pulling back as he walks straight towards the camera through deep snow, his long black overcoat moving, the helicopter and SUVs behind him, snow blowing around him
Smooth tracking shot as he walks past through the snow, men in long black coats holding rifles standing in a line on both sides of him lower their heads as he passes
Close-up, very slow push-in on his face, a flame reflected in his sunglasses, snowflakes landing on his beard, he does not blink

Aerial drone shot at night looking down: a convoy of black SUVs with headlights drives slowly along a snowy road through a dark pine forest towards an old stone fortress lit by burning fire braziers, snow falling. The camera stays high in the air the whole time; no people are visible anywhere, nobody gets out of the cars
Smooth steadicam shot pulling back as he walks slowly towards the camera through the snowy courtyard, men holding fire torches step back to both sides to make way
Medium shot: an old grey-bearded man in a heavy fur coat steps forward and grips his gloved hand with both hands, he places his other hand on his heart and nods slowly
Side tracking shot in slow motion as he walks across the snowy courtyard, snowflakes and fire embers drifting together, torchlight on his face

Wide shot from behind a line of tough rival men in fur hats and grey coats facing him across the snowy courtyard: one by one they drop their rifles into the snow and step back in fear, while he stands still and calm at the far side
Close-up: he slowly tilts his head, the faintest smile at one corner of his mouth, torchlight flickering, snow falling
Medium shot: he slowly raises one gloved open hand, palm out, and everyone around him freezes in silence, the torches flicker in the falling snow
Extreme close-up: he slowly takes off his sunglasses with his right gloved hand, his intense dark eyes look straight into the lens, upright normal framing
Low-angle hero shot: a huge wall of fire erupts along the snowy stone fortress wall behind him, every man raises his burning torch high and roars, he stands still in the snow
Smooth crane shot rising up and back: he stands at the centre of the snowy courtyard as hundreds of men with fire torches fill the fortress around him
Slow push-in from a low angle as he sits still on the fur-covered stone seat, torches below him, snow and smoke drifting across
Close-up: he slowly slides the sunglasses back on, smoke and snow drift across his face, he looks into the lens
Very slow push-in on him standing still on the snowy rampart, the wall of fire below, snowy mountains and a huge full moon, embers and snowflakes rising, his silhouette dark against the light

description:
Years ago his own land sent him away. Tonight a black helicopter came down in the snow, and every man in the valley lit a fire for him.

Music: Kingdom (main title theme) by ÆTHER, an original score. An original AI-made character, made as a tribute to the black-coat mass hero style of Malayalam cinema. Turn the volume up.
